title: The Silent Choir
author: Barış Kısır
premise: The village choir of St. Cuthbert\'s has sung the same festival anthem for sixty years — until the night the entire choir falls silent mid-hymn and the choirmaster is found dead in the organ loft. Music teacher Clara Fenwick, who can read the score like a confession, must find out what the choir has been hiding for six decades.
